Author: chefiffer
Name: Battlefield Frontline Collector
Description: Informational PvP recorder with local Frontline and Crystalline Conflict history, replay, optional upload, and server-generated Logs scoring. It never automates gameplay.
Punchline: Records and reviews Frontline and Crystalline Conflict matches.
Changelog: Add Korean language support, deprecate the legacy plugin data API, and include minor optimizations.
